## Audit: baseline B0

This was a **no-library baseline**: no capability was requested or loaded (`knowledge_words: 0`, `actual_loaded_capabilities: null`). The observed actions therefore show baseline behavior, not knowledge adoption. They also would not establish causation by a library had one been present. The supplied record does not include the original task wording, so the necessity of every implemented feature cannot be independently assessed.

**Exploration and changes.** `main_agent` created branch `error-stack-options`, searched for Error handling, and read `/app/src/transformer.ts`, `/app/src/index.ts`, `/app/src/plainer.ts`, package and TypeScript configuration (events 1–12). Several returned files and search results were truncated, limiting what can be inferred about the material actually visible to the student.

The student built a focused frames-mode reproduction at `/app/error-stack-repro.mjs`; before implementation it failed because the annotation was `Error`, not `Error/frames` (events 19–22). The final patch adds option normalization, stack processing, message sanitization and a class-processor registry in `/app/src/error-options.ts`, `/app/src/error-stack.ts`, `/app/src/error-sanitizer.ts` and `/app/src/error-class-registry.ts`. It updates `/app/src/index.ts` and `/app/src/transformer.ts` to expose configuration and apply Error serialization and restoration rules (events 23–44; supplied final patch). These are executable changes, not merely the student's later claim. The final patch includes frame/string modes, filtering and redaction, cause handling and AggregateError handling; the visible focused reproduction tests only a narrow frames-mode case.

**Validation and regressions.** The ordinary `npm run build` segfaulted before the chained reproduction could run (events 13–14). A TypeScript build with `--jitless` succeeded (events 17–18), and the focused reproduction passed after implementation (events 45–46). A `--jitless` Vitest invocation failed, but its diagnostic is truncated; its cause cannot be determined from the excerpt (events 47–48). With `--no-opt`, the local suite reported 81 passed, one failed performance test, one skipped and one todo: 1,939 ms against a 700 ms threshold (events 49–50). This is an observed local failure, not proof that the patch caused a performance regression: no comparable baseline timing is supplied, and optimization was disabled.

The subsequent local run excluded that performance test and reported 81 passed, two skipped and one todo (events 51–52). The student changed the cause-restoration guard, tested without it, and restored it afterward (events 53, 65–71). Thus the last full functional run was on the temporarily different version (events 67–68); after restoring the guard, the final build and focused reproduction passed before commit, but no full local suite rerun is shown (events 73–74). The final statement at event 75 accurately describes the local checks in broad terms, but is a student claim rather than independent evidence of broader coverage.

The **official evaluation is separate**: the supplied evaluation reports F2P 80/80, P2P 116/116 and binary reward 1, with verifier exit code 0. That supports formal success on this evaluation, not a claim of universal correctness. Source: `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_matched_prompt_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_B0_r1/eval_output/superjson-error-stack-serialization/eval_result.json`.

**Extra work and costs.** The student attempted formatting through a nonexistent Prettier path, then found and used the installed path (events 54–60). Formatting also changed unrelated presentation in `/app/src/index.ts`; the reproduction was removed before commit, and no new test file appears in the final patch (events 73–74). The guard flip and retries added work; whether the broader implementation was unnecessary is unassessable without the task specification. The run ended normally with commit `0b88219` and `end_turn`, not a budget or technical stop, despite the earlier crash. Reported selection metrics are 37 requested and returned tool calls, 21 model requests, 1,179,143 input and 6,101 output tokens, and 1,203.024 wall seconds. The SDK reports `total_cost_usd` 6.04824 as a **proxy estimate**, not actual CLI billing; no actual dollar fee is known.

Trajectory source for event IDs: `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_matched_prompt_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_B0_r1/infer_logs/superjson-error-stack-serialization/turn_1/trajs.json`.

| Capability/theme | Observed action | Event IDs | Inference limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loaded capability | None; B0 baseline | Metrics; no library event | No adoption or library causation can be assessed. |
| Exploration and reproduction | Read code; demonstrated missing frames annotation | `main_agent` 1–12, 19–22 | Several reads truncated; reproduction covers one case. |
| Implementation | Added options, stack helpers and Error rules | `main_agent` 23–44, 73–74 | Final patch establishes code changes, not correctness of every option. |
| Validation and regression | Local performance failure; filtered functional pass; final build/repro pass | `main_agent` 49–52, 65–74 | Failure cause unknown; last full functional run preceded final guard restoration. |
| Outcome | Committed; official F2P/P2P passed | `main_agent` 74–75; formal evaluation | Student claim is distinct from verifier results; success is evaluation-specific. |
